record.field: Who may bypass the protection on committed transactions, and who may read the deletion audit log.
Read access to the deletion audit log. The log holds a snapshot of every deleted record, so grant it only to people entitled to see that data.

Allows deletion of committed transactions when the session explicitly requests it. Grant sparingly: it exists for correcting data errors, not for day-to-day work. Every such deletion is recorded in the audit log and flagged.
